title: Prism Config
description: Configuration for Prism user and repository config.toml files.

program.description: Built-in adapter executable or wrapper. Prism owns protocol arguments.

arguments.description: Adapter-approved arguments placed before Prism-owned protocol arguments.

web_url.description: Optional browser base URL. Plain HTTP also requires allow_http.

api_url.description: Optional provider API base URL. Plain HTTP also requires allow_http.

credential_env.description: Name of the environment variable containing a Forgejo token. Never put the token here.

allow_http.description: Explicitly allow insecure HTTP for this host.

default_harness.description: Global harness ID. OpenCode, Codex, Claude, and Pi have built-in definitions; other IDs must be defined in the harnesses table.

default_base.description: Default branch for this repository. Prism does not treat this branch as a pull request branch.

review_packet_dir.description: Directory used for review packet files.

opencode_port_base.description: Base port for Prism-managed OpenCode servers.

opencode_port_span.description: Number of ports in the deterministic OpenCode server port range.

opencode_shutdown_owned_servers.description: Whether Prism should shut down OpenCode servers it started when Prism exits.

escape_key.description: Key sequence used to leave embedded terminal sessions.

merge_method.description: Merge method Prism requests for supported change requests.

icon_style.description: Status icon style. nerd-font requires a Nerd Font in the terminal.

notifications.description: Desktop notifications. Every value may be overridden by repository config.

enabled.description: Enable desktop notifications for live Agent Session transitions.

needs_input.description: Notify when active work begins waiting for input.

completed.description: Notify when active work completes successfully.

failed.description: Notify when active work fails or needs to be restarted.

sidebar_width.description: Preferred sidebar width in terminal columns.

columns.description: Extra wt list JSON columns shown in the worktree list.

remote_hosts.description: Explicit provider mappings for self-hosted Git remotes. github.com, gitlab.com, and codeberg.org are built in.

harnesses.description: Global harness definitions. opencode, codex, claude, and pi are reserved fixed built-in IDs; custom IDs must use the generic adapter.

prompt_templates.description: Prompt templates keyed by template name.
